description: This file defines a utility class for handling JNDI (Java Naming and Directory Interface) configurations, including loading and accessing JNDI server information from an XML configuration file.

classes.name: JNDIConfigUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods to load, initialize, and retrieve JNDI server configuration information.

classes.name: JNDIConfigUtil.JndiServerInfo
classes.description: Inner class representing individual JNDI server configuration details with accessor methods.

methods.name: getXmlRootElement
methods.description: Reads and returns the root XML Element from the JNDI configuration XML file.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the JNDI server info map from XML elements.

methods.name: getJndiServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the JNDI server information for a given name.

methods.name: JndiServerInfo (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs a JndiServerInfo object from an XML element.
